Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:

The Field Reliability Engineer (FRE) is an extension of Honeycomb’s extensive brand and technical expertise focused on our customer base via engagements, support and our managed services. In this role you parachute into the most complex, highest-stakes technical situations our customers face - unblocking them when they’re stuck, creating tooling, guiding our Solution Architecture team through complex decisions, and ensuring prospects and customers get the most out of Honeycomb and the broader observability ecosystem.

You’re equal parts platform engineer and customer engineer. You build and operate the managed infrastructure our largest customers depend on, and you’re the technical backstop the SA team calls when a deal gets deep into infrastructure, data pipelines, or production debugging. This isn’t a support role - it’s a technical leadership role where you solve problems that don’t have runbooks yet, build the platforms and tooling so the next person can have a runbook, and directly impact revenue by unblocking our most strategic deals.

What You’ll Do

Platform Engineering — Architecture & Standards Ownership

  • Define the architecture and operational standards for Refinery as a Service (RaaS) and Honeycomb Private Cloud (HnyPC) — decisions other engineers build within — across multiple AWS accounts and regions.
  • Architect the Terraform modules, Helm charts, and deployment automation that other FREs build on and extend, not just consume.
  • Set the technical direction for how Honeycomb instruments, monitors, and operates its own managed infrastructure — using Honeycomb to monitor Honeycomb.
  • Own capacity planning, scaling strategy, upgrade sequencing, and cost optimization across multi-region AWS environments.
  • Build platforms and automation that change how the FRE team operates at scale — enabling the team to grow without proportional headcount.

Technical Escalation & Unblocking

  • Serve as the final technical escalation point for the most novel, highest-stakes customer situations — problems with no precedent in existing runbooks.

Attention recruitment agencies: All agency inquiries are vetted through 4DMT’s internal Talent Acquisition team. No unsolicited resumes will be accepted. Agencies contacting hiring managers directly will not be tolerated, and doing so may impact your ability to work with 4DMT in the future.

4DMT is a leading late-stage biotechnology company advancing durable and disease-targeted therapeutics with potential to transform treatment paradigms and provide unprecedented benefits to patients. The Company’s lead product candidate 4D-150 is designed to be a backbone therapy forming the foundation of treatment of blinding retinal vascular diseases by providing multi-year sustained delivery of anti-VEGF (aflibercept and anti-VEGF-C) with a single, safe, intravitreal injection, which substantially reduces the treatment burden associated with current bolus injections. The Company’s lead indication for 4D-150 is wet age-related macular degeneration, which is currently in Phase 3 development, and second indication is diabetic macular edema. The Company’s second product candidate is 4D-710, which is the first known genetic medicine to demonstrate successful delivery and expression of the CFTR transgene in the lungs of people with cystic fibrosis after aerosol delivery

GENERAL SUMMARY:  

4DMT seeks a motivated and experienced Associate Clinical Trial Manager support the Company's clinical trial activities. This position will be responsible for supporting the day-to-day operations of one or more phase 1-3 clinical trials including trial start up, conduct and close-out activities. This role requires strong, professional written and verbal communication skills, good organization and attention to detail, and the ability to consistently provide high quality work while managing competing priorities and maintaining tight timelines. This person must be interested in working in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment and be willing to work beyond their job scope to achieve department and company objectives.

MAJOR DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:   

  • Coordinate tracking of a clinical trial(s) under the oversight of the Clinical Trial Management
  • Collect, track and conduct initial review for completeness of site regulatory documents for IP release and/or TMF filing
  • Organize, maintain and participate in audits and close out of the Trial Master File (TMF/eTMF)
  • Maintain multiple tracking spreadsheets following the progress of assigned clinical trials, such as study subject tracking, essential document tracking, and sample and investigational product tracking
  • Track and coordinate CRO and third-party vendor activities, including vendor provided meeting minutes, study updates and trackers
  • Receive and review all regulatory documents from sites (direct or through CRO) for accuracy and compliance to applicable SOPs and regulatory guidelines
  • Ensure timely updates are provided to CTM for updating of ‘Clinicaltrial.gov’ (site updates/changes)
  • Track and route new CDAs, contracts and Work Orders through established legal approval process (CTAs, MSAs, work/task orders)
  • Perform first pass review of all site and vendor invoices including tracking and generation of monthly/quarterly accruals for finance
  • Assist with the development of site tools and clinical trial start-up activities
  • Assist and/or contribute to the creation and maintenance of study materials for clinical studies, including but not limited to site and CRA training material, regulatory document templates, study binders, study plans/manuals, study communications and presentations
  • Assist in tracking of trial IP and development of Pharmacy Manuals
  • Participate in study vendor set up and specification process, as appropriate
  • Communicate directly with sites, Contract Research Organizations (CROs) and CRA/monitors to obtain updated information, essential documents, etc. to assist with driving start-up, study conduct, and/or close-out activities
  • Assist with tracking of clinical trial progress including status update reports, as requested
  • Assist with the organization, management and conduct of internal team meetings, investigator meetings and other trial-specific meetings, including minute taking and action item log tracking
  • Assist in tracking of clinical lab samples and central reader/lab data, including tracking of sample shipments and reconciliation
  • Utilize EDC/CTMS systems to acquire and synthesize data, metrics, or reports as necessary (enrollment data, randomizations, data cleaning, SAEs, etc.) for CTM, specific meetings or management updates
  • May assist CTM in tracking and follow-up of monitoring visit reports and unresolved issues
  • Willing to travel as business needs demand (<5% anticipated)
  • Other duties as may be assigned

Education:

  • B.A./B.S. degree required

Experience:

  • At least 5 years of work experience supporting clinical trials

Other Qualifications/Skills:

  • Basic knowledge of clinical trial operations, ICH GCP Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Proficient computer skills, specifically with Microsoft Office Suite that include Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Outlook
  • Ability to prioritize and manage competing priorities
  • Team oriented and ability to effectively collaborate with study team, cross-functional team members, and external partners

Travel: 30%

Fingering: Picking, pinching, typing or otherwise working, primarily with fingers rather than with whole hand or arm as in handling. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

jobs.description:
Who we are

Aquila, a group within Constellation Software Inc., one of North America’s largest and most respected software companies, invests in category-defining B2B and B2G software businesses globally, providing long-term support and strategic guidance. Emphasys Software has been part of Aquila since 2008.

Operating across five specialized divisions, Emphasys provides mission-critical software that modernizes and streamlines complex processes for housing authorities, lenders, and government agencies in nearly every state. Through both products and services, Emphasys helps house roughly half of the families most in need in the country.

At Emphasys PHA, a division of Emphasys, we develop and support industry-leading software designed specifically for Public Housing Authorities across the United States. As a trusted provider in the affordable housing sector, our solutions help PHAs efficiently manage operations, ensure regulatory compliance, and deliver critical housing services to families and individuals in need. From applicant intake to rent calculations and unit inspections, our platform supports the full lifecycle of public housing programs—empowering agencies to focus on their mission of providing safe, stable, and affordable housing.

Who we need

Reporting to the CEO, we are hiring a Director of Product Management to lead and strengthen our Product function. As our new Director of Product Management, you will bring greater structure, discipline, and strategic direction to how we define, prioritize, and deliver our product roadmap. Leading a team of three Product Owners, you will establish stronger product management practices, coach and develop the team, and partner closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to connect customer needs and market opportunities with business priorities. You will balance strategy with hands-on leadership as we evolve our product offering, including the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States.

What’s in it for you

The opportunity to shape the Product function. You will step into a team with deep industry knowledge and an opportunity to introduce the product management structure, practices, and operating rhythm that will help it evolve. You will have the autonomy to strengthen roadmapping, prioritization, and agile ways of working while coaching a team that is ready to build its product management capabilities. Your experience will directly influence how the function operates and how product decisions are made.

A meaningful product transformation. You will help guide the evolution of an established software product as we continue moving from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based platform. You will have the opportunity to balance customer needs and commitments with innovation and technical investment, helping determine what we build, why it matters, and where we focus next.

Evolve how Product works with AI. You will help the Product team adopt and mature AI-enabled ways of working, including the emerging AI Delivery Life Cycle (AI-DLC) methodology. As these practices continue to evolve across the organization, you will help the team explore where AI can strengthen product discovery, decision-making, development, and delivery, encouraging thoughtful experimentation while establishing practical approaches that can scale.

Influence and visibility. Reporting directly to the CEO, you will have a voice in decisions that connect product direction with customer needs, market opportunities, and business growth. You will work closely with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership and engage directly with customers, giving you broad exposure and the opportunity to influence both product strategy and how that strategy comes to life.

How you will make an impact:

  • Set the product direction. You will define and communicate a clear product vision and strategy, connecting customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities. You will translate that direction into a longer-term roadmap that gives teams greater clarity on where we are going, why it matters, and what comes next.
  • Bring structure to product management. You will establish stronger product management practices, operating rhythms, and agile ways of working. You will bring greater discipline to prioritization, backlog management, planning, and decision-making, helping the team move from reactive delivery toward a more consistent and strategic approach.
  • Lead the evolution of the product. You will help guide the continued transition from a legacy desktop application toward a more modern, web-based product. Partnering closely with Development, you will balance innovation, technical investment, customer commitments, and business priorities to support predictable, high-quality delivery.
  • Develop and empower the team. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of three Product Owners, building their product management capabilities and creating greater clarity around ownership and accountability. Initially operating as a player-coach, you will provide hands-on guidance while helping the team become increasingly strategic and effective.
  • Bring the customer into product decisions. You will engage directly with customers to understand their workflows, challenges, and priorities and bring those insights back into product strategy and planning. You will confidently present product direction, listen to feedback, and ensure customer needs are considered alongside broader market and business opportunities.
  • Connect Product across the business. You will partner with Development, Sales, Marketing, and industry leadership to create stronger alignment around product priorities and opportunities. Senior HR Business Partner

Job Details

Role: Senior HR Business Partner
Department: People & Culture
Job Location: Remote (Canada)

Total Compensation: $92,000 - $120,000 CAD + Benefits
New Hire Starting Pay: $92,000 - $102,000 CAD + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

Joining the Business Operations team as our Senior HR Business Partner, you'll partner with business leaders and collaborate closely with the People team to drive people strategy that reflects business priorities. You'll bring sharp technical HR expertise, data-driven judgment, and a growth mindset to every recommendation - owning core HR programs like promotions, performance reviews, employee relations, and employee listening surveys, and turning people data into insights leaders can act on with confidence.

Your focus will of responsibilities will be:

  • Domain: Own performance management processes, such as performance reviews and promotion cycles, from end to end. Handle employee relations matters with clear documentation and timely escalation. Implement employee listening surveys and translate results into action plans. Apply AI tools and modern HR technology to improve program quality and decision speed.
  • Client: Advise business leaders on employee relations, performance decisions, and HR concerns. Facilitate dialogue with stakeholders before finalizing recommendations. Balance risk mitigation with business needs. Deliver recommendations objectively and build credibility by speaking fluently in both HR and business terms.
  • People: Guide managers on HR practices and documentation, running performance conversations, and managing underperformance. Guide managers through promotion decisions to ensure fairness and consistency. Champion a culture of direct feedback and continuous growth.
  • Company: Bring precision and rigour to people program ownership and delivery. Identify and pilot AI and automation opportunities. Partner with senior leaders to shape people strategy. Translate people data into insights that inform workforce planning. Champion consistent, objective decision-making standards.

We’re committed to delivering an exceptional onboarding experience that will create a strong foundation for your launch in this role:

  • In your first 30 days you’ll get up to speed on Thrive's people programs, tools, and current initiatives, and start building relationships with the business leaders you'll support.
  • In your first 60 days you’ll begin owning components of core HR programs - performance reviews, employee relations cases, listening surveys - with guidance from the People team.
  • In your first 90 days you’ll be fully owning your programs end-to-end, delivering data-driven recommendations to leaders with confidence and autonomy.

Qualifications

  • You've owned end-to-end performance review or promotion cycles, from calibration through delivery, for a multi-team organization.
  • You've handled employee relations matters independently, balancing clear documentation, consistent policy application, and timely escalation.
  • You've designed or run employee listening surveys and translated results into action plans that leaders actually implemented.
  • You've used AI tools or modern HR technology to speed up people-data analysis or improve program delivery.
  • You've coached managers through hard conversations - feedback, underperformance, or promotion decisions - with a fair, development-oriented approach.
  • You're comfortable moving between HR technical rigour and business pragmatism, and leaders trust your judgment on sensitive calls.

---

Equal Opportunity Employer

Thrive is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace. We have zero tolerance for bullying, discrimination, or harassment of any kind, and we strive to create an environment where everyone feels safe, supported, and valued.

This commitment applies to all aspects of employment, including recruitment, hiring, performance management, training, compensation, and advancement. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in any stage of the selection process.

Competitive Total Compensation Package

At Thrive, we offer a competitive total compensation package that reflects role scope, experience, and impact. This includes a comprehensive benefits program with remote-first, flexible work, paid vacation and wellbeing time, career development support, internal career coaches, and robust health, dental, and paramedical coverage, and so much more!

The Use of Artificial Intelligence

Every application, interview, and candidate interaction at Thrive is reviewed and managed by a human. Where AI tools are used to support parts of the hiring process, candidates are informed and asked to provide consent.

Hiring Eligibility by Location

While Thrive operates as a remote-first organization and hires globally, work authorization requirements vary by role and location. Candidates must be legally authorized to work in the country where the role is based. For roles based in Canada, candidates must already be eligible to work in Canada. Thrive does not provide visa sponsorship.

Beware of Hiring Scams

Thrive Digital will never offer employment or request personal information outside of our official application process. While we do reach out to people on social channels, most commonly LinkedIn, with information about our active job posts, we always include a detailed recruitment package and a link to our careers page to apply. We do not reach out to candidates via text, WhatsApp or telegram or request any personal information. All recruiting communications will come from an @thrivedigital.com email address or our applicant tracking system (Greenhouse).

Thrive is a remote-first company with team members working across multiple regions. We recognize and respect the Indigenous histories of the lands where our team lives and works.

jobs.excerpt: À propos de nous nesto est une fintech canadienne fondée à Montréal en 2018.
jobs.description:
À propos de nous

nesto est une fintech canadienne fondée à Montréal en 2018. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin. Nous avons débuté comme courtier numérique misant sur la technologie pour apporter de la transparence au processus hypothécaire, puis nous avons bâti la principale plateforme canadienne de prêt hypothécaire en ligne directe aux consommateurs, où des experts hypothécaires qualifiés sont appuyés par une technologie de pointe.

Depuis, nous sommes devenus un écosystème hypothécaire complet, au service de grandes institutions financières partout au Canada à titre de partenaire B2B. Notre premier produit B2B a été lancé en 2022 avec IG Gestion de patrimoine. En 2024, nesto a fait l'acquisition du Groupe CMLS, formant ainsi le Groupe Nesto (nesto, CMLS et sa marque filiale Intellifi). Nous comptons aujourd'hui 1 300 employés répartis dans 12 bureaux à l'échelle du pays et 73 milliards de dollars canadiens d'actifs hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration.

Pourquoi nous recrutons

Notre croissance entraîne la création de nouvelles équipes de développement, et chaque équipe compte un(e) Développeur(euse) senior en automatisation QA (I ou II) au cœur de sa structure. Nous souhaitons aussi continuer à améliorer nos pratiques d'assurance qualité; nous avons donc besoin d'une personne capable de renforcer l'automatisation, de rehausser les normes de qualité et de façonner la manière dont nos équipes conçoivent et livrent leurs logiciels. Ce poste relève du chef ou de la cheffe d'équipe en ingénierie. Votre pile technologique quotidienne comprendra Playwright, Postman, Datadog, Docker, ArgoCD, GitHub, TypeScript et MySQL. Comme indiqué dans la section « Ce que vous apportez », nous ne nous attendons pas à ce que vous les maîtrisiez tous.

Lieu de travail et disponibilité

Ce poste, en mode télétravail d'abord, est ouvert aux candidat(e)s partout au Canada. Travaillez de la maison ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux, notamment à Montréal, Toronto, Vancouver, Winnipeg, Ottawa et Calgary.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Concevoir, bâtir et maintenir des suites de tests automatisés robustes et évolutives avec Playwright, en appliquant les meilleures pratiques et les patrons de conception de l'industrie afin d'assurer leur maintenabilité à long terme.
  • Collaborer avec les développeurs et les gestionnaires de produit tout au long du cycle de développement logiciel (SDLC) pour clarifier les exigences, repérer les lacunes tôt et définir les critères d'acceptation lors des cérémonies Agiles.
  • Piloter la qualité tant du côté des tests d'interface (UI) que des tests d'API, en tirant parti des signaux de surveillance, des revues d'incidents et de la rétroaction des clients pour cibler les occasions d'amélioration.
  • Exploiter l'IA de façon novatrice pour soutenir et accélérer les tâches de développement en automatisation de l'AQ.
  • Prendre en charge les résultats de qualité au sens large en demeurant impliqué(e) au-delà de l'exécution des tests, afin d'améliorer les processus, la documentation et les méthodes de travail de l'équipe.
  • Adopter un état d'esprit d'amélioration continue en restant à l'affût des nouveaux outils, technologies et méthodologies de test.
  • Collaborer avec les développeurs(-euses) staff en automatisation de l'AQ pour améliorer les processus et les pratiques d'assurance qualité à l'échelle de l'organisation.
  • Travailler avec les gestionnaires de produit pour définir des plans de tests complets à partir des documents de conception, comme les PRD et les HLD.
  • Soutenir les tests d'acceptation par les utilisateurs (UAT) pour les projets clés, par exemple lors de l'intégration de nouveaux partenaires ou clients.
  • Réviser et exécuter des cas et des scripts de tests manuels pour les fonctionnalités en développement à l'aide d'outils de gestion et de suivi des tests, afin de fournir à l'équipe de projet une rétroaction sur leur potentiel d'automatisation.
  • Valider manuellement les fonctionnalités selon les plans de tests et intégrer ces scénarios à la suite de tests de régression automatisés.

Ce que vous apportez

  • Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité sur des applications SaaS ou infonuagiques, avec une compréhension approfondie du cycle de développement logiciel complet et de la place de l'ingénierie de la qualité dans le processus de développement.
  • Plus de 2 ans d'expérience pratique avec un cadre d'automatisation comme Playwright, Cypress ou un outil similaire, avec une capacité démontrée à créer, maintenir et faire évoluer des suites de tests de bout en bout (E2E).
  • Un état d'esprit « automatisation d'abord », avec des antécédents démontrant la priorité accordée à la couverture automatisée plutôt qu'à l'AQ uniquement manuelle, et l'intégration de la fiabilité dans le pipeline CI/CD.
  • Une capacité de test pleine pile couvrant les couches UI et API, y compris de l'expérience avec des outils comme Postman pour la validation d'API, assurant une couverture complète à tous les niveaux de la pile.
  • Une expertise en architecture de tests et en conception évolutive, avec la capacité de bâtir des suites d'automatisation maintenables selon les patrons de conception standards de l'industrie (p. ex. Page Object Model, fabriques de données, séparation des responsabilités).
  • Une aisance avec la méthodologie Agile et ses outils, incluant le confort de travailler dans des environnements de livraison rapide avec des cycles de mise en production fréquents, et une familiarité avec des plateformes de gestion de tests comme Allure TestOps pour le suivi et les rapports.
  • Une solide expérience avec TypeScript et/ou Go est un atout, tout comme l'expérience avec MySQL ou une base de données relationnelle similaire.

Ce poste est peut-être pour vous si

  • Vous abordez l'automatisation avec un état d'esprit de génie logiciel, en appliquant la même rigueur, les mêmes patrons de conception et les mêmes normes d'évolutivité qu'un développeur applique à une fonctionnalité clé.
  • Vous êtes un(e) adepte du « Shift Left » (tests en amont) qui clarifie les exigences dès la planification, bien avant l'écriture de la première ligne de code.
  • Vous avez une vision globale de la qualité, fondée sur les données, qui va au-delà des tests d'interface de base pour exploiter les tests d'API, les signaux système et la rétroaction des clients afin de trouver des pistes d'amélioration.
  • Vous êtes tourné(e) vers l'IA et curieux(-euse) sur le plan technique, et vous expérimentez avec des outils modernes pour affiner votre stratégie et accroître votre impact.
  • Vous améliorez continuellement les façons de faire de l'équipe et prenez en charge les processus et la documentation sans qu'on vous le demande.

Vous ne devriez pas postuler si

  • Vous êtes principalement testeur(-euse) manuel(le) et ne souhaitez pas concevoir l'automatisation ni apprendre de nouvelles technologies.
  • Vous préférez une approche réactive de type « cascade », où vous attendez la fin du développement avant de vous impliquer.
  • Vous cherchez un rôle étroit et à portée fixe, où vous exécutez des tests plutôt que de remettre en question les exigences et de repérer les lacunes.
  • Vous préférez travailler en vase clos et ne souhaitez pas améliorer les méthodes de travail, la documentation ou les processus de qualité de l'équipe.
  • Vous n'êtes pas prêt(e) à intégrer les outils d'IA dans votre travail quotidien.

Processus d'entrevue

  • Entrevue avec le recruteur (30 minutes) : une première conversation sur votre parcours et le poste.
  • Exercice à faire à la maison : une étude de cas que l'équipe évalue pour déterminer votre niveau technique.
  • Entrevue technique (60 minutes) : une plongée technique avec deux de nos développeurs(-euses) staff en automatisation de l'AQ, incluant une discussion de votre étude de cas.
  • Entrevue finale (60 minutes) : une entrevue non technique avec l'équipe d'embauche.
  • Étape de l'offre : vérifications des antécédents, du casier judiciaire et des références, suivies d'une offre formelle.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Couverture santé complète : assurance maladie complémentaire, soins dentaires et soins de la vue de premier ordre, avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Compte de dépenses santé et mieux-être : un fonds flexible annuel combiné de 1 500 $ pour les abonnements au gym ou les besoins médicaux supplémentaires.
  • Congés payés généreux : 4 semaines de vacances, plus 8 journées personnelles flottantes.
  • Épargne-retraite : un régime collectif REER/RPDB avec des cotisations de contrepartie concurrentielles de l'employeur.
  • Télémédecine : accès via Dialogue et couverture des services de praticiens agréés.
  • Soutien à la famille : programmes de complément de salaire pour les congés de maternité et les congés parentaux.
  • Travail flexible : entièrement en télétravail ou depuis l'un de nos bureaux à Montréal, Calgary, Toronto, Vancouver et ailleurs.

Pourquoi vous joindre à nous

  • Hypercroissance : palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte, trois années consécutives.
  • Crédibilité dans la communauté techno : Canadian Rocketship 2025 de TechTO.
  • Leadership dans l'industrie : Lending Company of the Year de la CLA, quatre années consécutives.
  • Reconnaissance des talents : CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025.
  • Technologie de confiance : au service de grandes institutions financières partout au Canada.
  • Une culture fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, des normes élevées et un véritable souci des gens que nous servons.

Diversité et inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration naissent d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous nous engageons à bâtir un milieu de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes racisées, les personnes LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à poser leur candidature.

Veuillez noter qu'étant donné que nous servons des client(e)s situé(e)s dans tout le Canada, il est essentiel d'être bilingue pour ce poste. Vous pourriez être amené(e) à communiquer en français et en anglais.

jobs.description:
The Risk Adjustment Quality & Review Analyst in IFP brings medical coding and Hierarchical Condition Category expertise to the role, evaluates complex medical conditions, determines compliance of medical documentation, identifies trends, and suggests improvements in data and processes for Continuous Quality Improvement (CQI).

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Conduct medical records reviews with accurate diagnosis code abstraction in accordance with Official Coding Guidelines and Conventions, Cigna IFP Coding Guidelines and Best Practices, HHS Protocols and any additional applicable rule set.

  • Utilize HHS’ Risk Adjustment Model to confirm accuracy of Hierarchical Condition Categories (HCC) identified from abstracted ICD-10-CM diagnosis codes for the correct Benefit Year.

  • Apply longitudinal thinking to identify all valid and appropriate data elements and opportunities for data capture, through the lens of HHS’ Risk Adjustment.

  • Perform various documentation and data audits with identification of gaps and/or inaccuracies in risk adjustment data and identification of compliance risks in support of IFP Risk Adjustment (RA) programs, including the Risk Adjustment Data Validation (RADV) audit and the Supplement Diagnosis submission program. Inclusive of Quality Audits for vendor coding partners.

  • Collaborate and coordinate with team members and matrix partners to facilitate various aspects of coding and Risk Adjustment education with internal and external partners.

  • Coordinate with stake holders to execute efficient and compliant RA programs, raising any identified risks or program gaps to management in a timely manner.

  • Communicate effectively across all audiences (verbal & written).

  • Develop and implement internal program processes ensuring CMS/HHS compliant programs, including contributing to Cigna IFP Coding Guideline updates and policy determinations, as needed.

Qualifications

  • High school diploma

  • 2+ years’ experience in one of the following Coding Certifications by either the American Health Information Management Association (AHIMA) or the American Academy of Professional Coders (AAPC):

    • Certified Professional Coder (CPC)

    • Certified Coding Specialist for Providers (CCS-P)

    • Certified Coding Specialist for Hospitals (CCS-H)

    • Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT)

    • Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA)

    • Certified Risk Adjustment Coder (CRC) certification

    • Individuals who have a certification other than the CRC must become CRC certified within 6 months of hire.

  • Experience with medical documentation audits and medical chart reviews and proficiency with ICD-10-CM coding guidelines and conventions

  • Familiarity with CMS regulations for Risk Adjustment programs and policies related to documentation and coding compliance, with both Inpatient and Outpatient documentation

  • HCC coding experience preferred

  • Computer competency with excel, MS Word, Adobe Acrobat

  • Must be detail oriented, self-motivated, and have excellent organization skills

  • Understanding of medical claims submissions is preferred

  • Ability to meet timeline, productivity, and accuracy standards

We are looking for a CS Transformation & Implementation Specialist to join our team and help us shape the next generation of internal platforms supporting the traveller’s journey.

If you are passionate about turning complexity into scalable solutions, leveraging AI to improve operational workflows, and thriving at the intersection of CS Operations, Product, and Technology, keep on reading, you might be the perfect fit for this role.

The job in brief:

  • Job Title - CS Transformation & Implementation Specialist
  • Working model - Remote from Spain, Portugal or Romania
  • Team - You will join the Product Customer Service team within the Product department
  • Level - Professional
  • Location - Spain
  • Contract - Full time (36 h/week)
  • Travel time required - Only a few times a year

What your impact will be:

You will play a central, key role in a major Customer Service transformation: renewing our omnichannel platform, redesigning operational workflows, and scaling AI and automation across the department.

You will sit between the technical teams and the Customer Service population, translating in both directions. Covering the full arc of a change, from understanding how the operation works today, designing target workflows inside a new system, to building, launching, and proving real business impact, you will ensure our internal tools simplify daily work, improve efficiency, and contribute to a smoother experience for our travellers.

What You Will Need to Solve:

Shape and deliver a new customer operations platform:

  • Take end-to-end ownership of key areas of a new AI-ready back-office and customer operations platform, including cloud omnichannel migrations (with direct Zendesk implementation involvement).
  • Lead discovery activities to analyze current operational workflows, triaging, routing, escalations, and pain points across all contact channels.
  • Help define the future operational model, solution design, workflow logic, service-level rules, taxonomy, and data structures in collaboration with business and technology stakeholders.
  • Challenge legacy processes and support the transition towards a modern, scalable platform, defining structured requirements and realistic roadmaps.

Drive AI and automation initiatives:

  • Identify manual, repetitive, and low-value activities across the operation and design solutions that remove them.
  • Scope and deliver AI-enabled solutions (such as conversational AI, intelligent triage and routing, agent assist/copilot tools, generative replies, automated summarization, or quality monitoring).
  • Structure operational knowledge and content so that it is reliably usable by both agents and AI systems.
  • Critically evaluate where AI and automation genuinely add value versus where they risk degrading the user experience or simply shifting complexity elsewhere.

  • Lead implementation from discovery through configuration, migration, testing, cutover, and post go-live stabilization.
  • Translate operational needs into clear specifications, BPMN process models, user stories, and iterative releases.
  • Balance strategic thinking with execution rigor, prioritizing backlog items based on value, feasibility, and operational impact.
  • Continuously adapt priorities based on business needs, operational feedback, and product insights while taking accountability for outcomes.

  • Design the operational reporting framework in new systems and ensure continuity with existing performance baselines.
  • Leverage workflow orchestration tools, low-code/no-code platforms, RPA, and system integrations via APIs/connectors to streamline processes across the traveller journey.
  • Model complex end-to-end flows, understanding how a change in one step affects the rest of the chain to maintain a simple, reliable platform.

Collaborate with stakeholders and teams:

  • Act as the key connector between CS Operations, Product, IT, Data, and Machine Learning teams.
  • Align cross-functional stakeholders with different priorities on scope, risks, timelines, and trade-offs, influencing without formal authority.
  • Drive platform adoption through structured enablement, training, and change management engagement.
  • Monitor performance after launch, measuring real impact against established operational KPIs to prove the change delivered what it promised.

Your expertise:

  • Around 5 years of experience in transformation delivery, product ownership, business analysis, or systems implementation in medium to large organisations.
  • Direct hands-on experience implementing, configuring, or operating leading cloud customer service platforms; direct Zendesk implementation experience is required (in an implementation, business analysis, or operations capacity).
  • Strong discovery and solution design skills, including BPMN workflow modeling, requirement gathering, and data classification/taxonomy design.
  • Proven experience delivering automation and AI initiatives in customer service or operations (e.g., GenAI, LLMs, conversational AI, intelligent routing, or agent assist tools).
  • Advanced proficiency in operational data analysis (Excel, Google Sheets, BI tools) with a focus on baselining, KPI tracking, and impact measurement.
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional stakeholders, navigating complexity, and leading end-to-end delivery from cutover to post-launch optimization.
  • Strong user-centric mindset with deep empathy for internal operational teams and travellers.
  • Fluency in English, both spoken and written (mandatory).

Desirable:

  • Zendesk certification (e.g., Zendesk Support Administrator Expert, Zendesk Administrator).
  • Experience in the travel or travel-tech/tourism industry.
  • Background in large-scale customer service, back-office platforms, CRM systems, or complex process transformation initiatives.
  • Practical experience with workflow automation tools, RPA, or API integrations.
  • Working knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum/Kanban) or Agile certifications (e.g., PMI-ACP, Scrum Master).
  • Familiarity with structured Change Management approaches (such as ADKAR or Prosci certification).
  • Multi-brand and multi-language platform setup experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Reporting continuity is maintained across the transition, with a reliable baseline to measure performance against.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Field CTO, RSA ID Plus

Location: United States (Remote)

Reports to: VP Product, Access Management

RSA provides trusted identity and access management for 12,000 organizations around the world, managing 25 million enterprise identities and providing secure, convenient access to millions of users. RSA specializes in empowering security-first organizations in financial services, healthcare, energy, technology services, and other industries to thrive in a digital world, delivering complete capabilities for modern authentication, access, lifecycle management, and identity governance. Whether in the cloud or on-premises, RSA connects people with the digital resources they depend on everywhere they live, work, and play.

For decades, RSA has pioneered many of the encryption, authentication, and identity federation technologies that still power the internet. And now RSA is transforming the industry yet again, paving the way for the future of digital identity through the RSA Unified Identity Platform; next-generation hybrid and cloud solutions; the first ever and only multi-functional, passwordless hardware authenticator; and a frictionless, mobile-optimized experience for the modern workforce. If you are self-motivated and looking for a fast-paced challenge doing something that truly matters, come join our winning team! For more information, go to rsa.com.

Why This Role Matters

Identity is the control plane of modern zero trust security, and Access Management is at its very core. Every application, workload, and AI agent now asks the same question before anything else happens: who is this user, and should they be granted access? Access Management is where these question gets answered, thousands of times per second, for organizations that cannot afford to get it wrong. Today, a confluence of market forces—including emerging anti-phishing mandates, sophisticated AI-powered threats, and the rise of agentic and other non-human identities—are dramatically reshaping the Access Management landscape and opening new opportunities for innovation and growth.

RSA ID Plus sits at the center of this market shift. Recognized as a leading Access Management solution with more than 3000 customers in 100+ countries worldwide, RSA ID Plus is trusted by the world’s most security-sensitive organizations including 70% of Fortune 100 Financial Services, 90% of US Federal Agencies, and more that 65 International Governments around the globe. What makes RSA different is our cybersecurity DNA, 40+ years of redefining the identity security market, and our laser focus on securing the world’s most secure. RSA ID Plus is the only identity platform that provides true passwordless from cloud to desktop to the datacenter, ensures continuous assurance beyond phishing to tackle today’s most advanced identity threats, and can be deployed in any environment including multi-tenant SaaS, private cloud, on-premises, and even air-gapped environments.

Job Description

The Field CTO is the most senior technical voice for RSA ID Plus in the market. This individual will serve as a trusted advisor to CISOs, CIOs, and enterprise architects at our most strategic accounts, shape the technical narrative for the platform, and represent RSA with industry analysts, at industry events, and in the public forum. The role sits at the intersection of technology, strategy, and the field: equally comfortable whiteboarding a zero trust architecture with a customer's security team and briefing executives on where the identity market is heading.

The successful candidate must be a recognized identity and cybersecurity expert with the credibility to hold the room in front of a Fortune 100 security organization or a federal agency, and the commercial instinct to turn that credibility into pipeline and design wins. Just as importantly, they will carry what they learn in the field back into the business, translating customer conversations, competitive encounters, and market signals into a sharper strategy and a stronger story for ID Plus. This is a highly visible, self-directed role for someone who thrives on a large cross-functional team and leads through influence rather than authority.

The successful Field CTO will:

  • Serve as trusted technical advisor to RSA's most strategic customers and prospects, engaging CISOs, CIOs, and enterprise architects on identity strategy, zero trust architecture, and modernization roadmaps.
  • Act as the primary technical evangelist for ID Plus through keynotes, conference sessions, webinars, whitepapers, and executive briefings, and lead analyst briefings alongside Product Management and Product Marketing.
  • Support complex, high-value sales cycles in regulated and enterprise environments, partnering with Sales and Solution Architecture to remove technical obstacles and win architectural decisions.
  • Maintain a rigorous view of the competitive landscape, from technical capability comparisons to positioning implications, and equip the field with the arguments needed to win against it.
  • Partner with Product Management and Product Marketing to shape platform strategy, refine positioning and messaging, and feed field insight into long-range strategic planning.
  • Build the technical credibility of the broader field organization through enablement, architecture guidance, and mentoring of solution architects and sales engineers.

Qualifications

  • 12+ years in senior technical roles such as Field CTO, Chief Architect, Principal Solution Architect, or Security Strategist, with extensive customer-facing experience.
  • Deep subject matter expertise in Identity & Access Management principles, including major technology standards in authentication (NIST SP800-63, FIDO2, X.509), federation and authorization (SAML, OAuth 2.0, OIDC), and emerging technologies (SSF, Verifiable Credentials).
  • Demonstrated ability to design and defend enterprise security architectures across SaaS, private cloud, on-premises, and air-gapped environments.
  • Proven executive presence and commercial acumen, with a track record of advising CISOs and CIOs and influencing large, complex enterprise sales cycles without owning a quota.
  • Established industry voice, evidenced by conference speaking, published thought leadership, analyst engagement, or standards body participation.
  • Strong analytical skills and command of the competitive landscape, able to translate technical differentiation into defensible positioning and messaging, and to contribute that insight to product strategy and long-range planning.
  • Superior written and verbal communication skills, equally effective on a keynote stage, in a customer architecture review, and in an executive strategy discussion.
  • Independent self-starter who sets direction in ambiguity and operates effectively across a large, globally distributed organization.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30% for customer meetings, industry events, and speaking engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Computer Science; advanced degree a plus.

Pay Range $170,000 - $270,000

Full-time, non-Sales US employees are also eligible for annual discretionary bonuses that are funded based on prior year company performance. RSA Sales team members are eligible to participate in company commission plans.

In addition, RSA offers its eligible US employees a comprehensive array of benefit programs including flexible paid-time-off, health, disability, and life insurance, and a 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions.

All employment decisions at RSA are based on business needs, job requirements and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union or domestic partnership status, protected veteran status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. RSA will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. All RSA employees are expected to support this policy and contribute to an environment of equal opportunity.

About the Working Families Party

The Working Families Party (WFP) is the progressive party for the multiracial working class, fighting for a nation that works for the many, not the few. We recruit, train, and support transformational candidates up and down the ballot — and run them to win.
We believe that no matter where we come from or what our color, most of us want the same things. We want to earn enough to thrive, not just survive, and leave a better future for our kids. We want healthy food and clean water, safe neighborhoods and a safe world. We want to be free.
The Working Families Party is regular people coming together across our differences to make a better future for us all. We’re a multiracial party that fights for workers over bosses and people over the powerful. We want an America which realizes the promise – unrealized in our history – of freedom and equality for all.

ABOUT THIS ROLE

The Director of Coalition Alignment & Governance Strategy is a senior leadership position responsible for ensuring strategic alignment across California Working Families Party's governance structures, regional leadership bodies, staff teams, and elected champions. This role serves as the primary bridge between the State Steering Committee, Regional Committees, elected officials, organizational partners, and staff leadership to ensure that CA WFP operates as a cohesive statewide political organization.

The Director will lead the development and implementation of California WFP's co-governance strategy, helping elected officials and movement leaders govern together around shared priorities while strengthening the party's long-term political infrastructure. The ideal candidate will be an experienced coalition builder, political strategist, facilitator, and manager who can navigate complex relationships, build alignment across diverse stakeholders, and drive execution on statewide priorities.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

    Party Governance and Regional Alignment

  • Collaborate closely with the State Director, CA WFP Officers, and State Steering Committee to develop and implement statewide political, organizational, and governing strategies.

  • Serve as the primary staff lead for the California State Steering Committee, including agenda development, meeting facilitation, follow-up, implementation tracking, and leadership development.

  • Manage regional steering committees as assigned by the State Director

  • Staff the work of the CA WFP Officers and provide strategic support related to governance, party growth, regional alignment, and organizational development.

  • Ensure strong alignment between statewide priorities and Regional Committee strategies, programs, and decision-making processes.

  • Build systems that improve communication, coordination, accountability, and collaboration between regional and statewide leadership bodies.

  • Support the ongoing development of democratic governance structures that strengthen participation, accountability, and strategic decision-making across the organization.

  • Manage the annual dues collections from coalition members.

  • Coordinate communication, workflow, and strategic alignment between State Steering Committee members, Regional Committees, staff, and organizational partners.

    • Governance and Elected Leadership Strategy

  • Lead the development and execution of California WFP's statewide co-governance strategy.

  • Plan and execute annual statewide governance and co-governance convenings.

  • Support the planning and facilitation of regional governance and co-governance gatherings throughout the state.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with elected officials, candidates, labor leaders, movement organizations, and coalition partners.

  • Coordinate regular engagement opportunities for elected officials, including statewide elected official meetings, issue-based governing discussions, and strategic planning sessions.

  • Develop and facilitate a monthly statewide elected officials call focused on policy priorities, governing opportunities, movement alignment, and shared strategy.

  • Coordinate issue-based co-governance campaigns that connect elected officials, movement organizations, and party leaders around common priorities.

  • Work closely with regional leadership and elected champions to establish regional co-governance tables and governing structures.

  • Support elected officials in building stronger relationships with movement organizations and community leaders throughout California.

    • Staff Management and Organizational Leadership

  • Supervise staff as assigned by the State Director.

  • Support cross-department coordination to ensure organizing, electoral, governance, communications, and development work are aligned with statewide priorities.

  • Participate as a senior leader in organizational planning, staff development, and strategic decision-making.

  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and political alignment across staff teams.

    • Political Strategy and Coalition Building

  • Maintain strong relationships with labor unions, community organizations, member leaders, donors, elected officials, and movement allies.

  • Identify opportunities to strengthen California WFP's political infrastructure, coalition relationships, and governing power throughout the state.

  • Represent California WFP in coalition spaces, governance tables, and strategic political discussions as assigned by the State Director.

  • Support the development of long-term political strategies that connect electoral success to governing power and durable movement-building.

  • Work across departments and stakeholder groups to ensure California WFP functions as an integrated statewide political organization.

  • Lead special projects and strategic initiatives as assigned by the State Director.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS

  • Organizational Leadership: At least 8 years of experience serving as an advisor, strategist, or senior leader within political, labor, advocacy, or democratic organizations. Proven ability to build alignment across diverse stakeholders and translate strategy into action.

  • Governance and Coalition Management: Deep experience managing coalitions, steering committees, boards, elected leaders, or other governing bodies. Strong understanding of relationship building, consensus development, and organizational decision-making.

  • Exceptional People Leadership: Proven experience managing staff; setting expectations; developing talent; leading performance management; and building strong, trust-based relationships across lines of difference.

  • Co-Governance and Political Strategy: Experience working with elected officials, candidates, labor unions, and community organizations to advance shared governing, policy, or political priorities. Knowledge of California's political and movement ecosystem preferred.

  • Superior Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to facilitate complex conversations, navigate competing interests, and translate political and organizational priorities into clear guidance, decisions, and systems that support alignment and execution.

About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Engineer to take technical ownership of complex products and systems and raise the engineering bar across the team.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will be expected to design systems, write and review code, solve difficult engineering problems, guide other engineers and drive major initiatives from idea to production.

You should be comfortable moving between architecture and implementation — making strong technical decisions while still being close enough to the code to execute when needed.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the technical design and execution of major products, features and engineering initiatives.

  • Design scalable, reliable and maintainable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Stay hands-on with engineering through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Make architecture decisions and technical trade-offs that balance speed, scalability, reliability and maintainability.

  • Break ambiguous product and technical problems into clear engineering solutions and execution plans.

  • Set a high bar for code quality, system design, testing, security, observability and production reliability.

  • Review technical designs and code from other engineers and provide clear, actionable feedback.

  • Mentor engineers and help strengthen technical capability across the team.

  • Identify technical risks, bottlenecks and architectural weaknesses before they become larger problems.

  • Work closely with engineering, product, design and AI teams to ship high-quality products quickly.

  • Improve engineering tooling, development practices and automation to increase team velocity.

  • Own systems beyond release — monitor production, investigate incidents, resolve root causes and continuously improve reliability.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering background with significant experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills with experience making technical decisions for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Proven experience leading major engineering projects or providing technical leadership to other engineers.

  • Comfortable reviewing code, debugging complex issues and working directly with production systems.

  • Able to explain complex technical decisions clearly and influence engineers across teams.

  • Strong product sense and ability to connect technical decisions to customer and business outcomes.

  • Able to work fast with ambiguity and take ownership from problem definition through production.

  • Strong judgment around when to move quickly, when to simplify and when deeper engineering investment is required.

This Role Is Not For

  • Engineers who want a leadership title but no longer want to write or review code.

  • People who only want to work within one narrow technical area.

  • Engineers who wait for complete specifications before starting.

  • Candidates who over-engineer solutions when a simpler approach would achieve the outcome.

  • Engineers who focus only on implementation without understanding the product or business problem.

  • People who avoid production incidents, difficult debugging or ownership after release.

  • Candidates who make vague claims about technical leadership without being able to explain what they personally designed, built, shipped or scaled.

The Bar

We are looking for technical leaders with real engineering career highlights.

A strong highlight is not simply having a senior title or working at a famous technology company. A strong highlight means you personally designed, built, shipped or scaled a serious product, platform or system and can go deep into the technical decisions behind it.

You should be able to demonstrate both technical depth and technical leadership — someone who can solve difficult engineering problems personally while making the engineers around them stronger.

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Classification: Regular Full-time (Non-exempt), Skill Band A

Location: Remote in WA State (Pierce County Preferred)

Reports to: King & Pierce Clinic Manager

The Client Coordinator plays a critical role in connecting community members with affordable veterinary services while ensuring a positive, equitable, and compassionate client experience. Serving as the primary point of contact for clients seeking spay/neuter and vaccine services, this position is responsible for coordinating appointments, maintaining accurate records, supporting community partnerships, and fostering trusting relationships with clients and partners.

Working collaboratively with the Clinic Manager and Pet Services team, the Client Coordinator ensures scheduling, client communications, and partner relationships are handled efficiently, accurately, and compassionately. This role regularly engages with underserved and marginalized communities and requires a strong commitment to reducing barriers to care, promoting animal welfare, and supporting the organization's mission.

The successful candidate will be a skilled communicator who excels at both client service and detailed administrative work, while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and accountability.

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Serve as the primary point of contact for Pierce County clients, and community members, addressing their inquiries and concerns promptly and professionally, via email, text, and phone calls with compassion, clarity, and kindness.

  • Work collaboratively with the Regional Clinic Manager and Pet Services administration team to maintain consistent scheduling practices and client communication. Ensure all scheduling and client relations are effective, equitable, and clearly documented.
  • Coordinate and schedule client appointments for spay/neuter and vaccine clinics, ensuring efficient use of resources and meeting client needs.
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with clients including voucher partners, volume partners, and community organizations.
  • Engage compassionately and equitably with clients with a focus on building relationships and trust.
  • Maintain accurate client records, appointment information, and program documentation, while ensuring confidentiality and data security.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support seamless service delivery and effective communication across programs.
  • Ensure compliance with all clinic policies, procedures, and operational standards
  • Assist with program outreach, client engagement efforts, and community education activities as needed.
  • Support special projects and other duties as assigned by management.

Required Skills/Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated passion for animal welfare and commitment to reducing pet overpopulation, shelter over crowding, animal suffering, and unnecessary euthanasia.
  • Commitment to being part of the solution to animal cruelty and barriers to veterinary care.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate clearly, professionally, and compassionately with diverse audiences.
  • Strong customer service skills and commitment to creating positive client experiences.
  • Be a team player with a collaborative and communicative style.
  • Possess ability to be diplomatic, compassionate, and direct, especially in difficult situations. Having strong de-escalation abilities is a plus.
  • Have a natural aptitude for working empathically with marginalized populations with a commitment to address racial and economic injustice.
  • Must have prior experience working with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel); and be highly confident in ability to learn new software applications. Previous experience with ClinicHQ or databases is helpful.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, enabling efficient management of client appointments and records.
  • Must be a self-starter, able to prioritize effectively, possess exceptional organizational
  • Ability to multitask and prioritize tasks in a fast-paced environment, ensuring timely delivery of services to clients.
  • Ability to adapt quickly to changing circumstances.
  • Frequently sit, keyboard, and wrist (flexion/extension)
  • Occasionally stand/walk, grasp, and fine manipulation
  • Seldomly twist, bend/stoop, squat/kneel, crawl, reach or work above shoulders.
  • Occasionally lift, carry, push/pull 1lb-10lb

Employee Benefits:

  • Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance (100% employer paid premium for employee coverage)
  • 401(k) + Company match up to 2% - Fully vested on day 1
  • Discretionary Time Off
  • Paid Holidays (9 per year)
  • Supplemental Insurance Benefits available
  • At cost veterinary care, medications and pet food, when available
  • Pawternity leave and animal family member bereavement
  • Relocation assistance for out of WA state candidates
  • Opportunities for Advancement

Employment Details:

  • Regular Full-Time, Non-Exempt (36 hours per week).
  • Remote in WA State, Pierce County preferred.
  • Shift is Monday-Friday, standard shift is to be determined by clinic operational needs.
  • Occasional local travel, weekend and evening coverage required.

It is not a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned this position. Furthermore, nothing in this job description restricts management’s ability to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time. That contribution is not limited by the assigned responsibilities in this job description.
