Who We Are:

We are a tech-enabled growth firm–at the intersection of marketing, consulting & data intelligence–igniting revenue and brand recognition for leading and emerging companies around the world. As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. Our vision is to be recognized as the most valued and respected private growth marketing firm in the world–with a scalable brand, culture and services. Our mission is to power the relentless pursuit of growth and redefine what’s possible through a team of growth-obsessed experts who demand innovation and results - driven by integrity, autonomy, and grit.

As a full-service growth marketing firm, we offer best-in-class services including: SEO, Content Marketing, Paid Media, Social Media Marketing, Programmatic + CTV, Public Relations, Influencer Marketing, Email + SMS, Conversion Rate Optimization, Retail Marketing, and Creative. Here at Power Digital, we are hyper-focused on helping brands drive revenue growth and brand recognition, ultimately driving irrefutable value for our clients.

At the heart of Power Digital is our proprietary technology, nova, which analyzes businesses through first-party data, simplifying investment planning for marketing and diligence in M&A––putting marketers in a strategic seat at the table––and providing value in unparalleled ways.

Managing billions in media, our dynamic team––of consultative marketers, creatives, analysts and technologists––challenge traditional ways of planning and measurement through meticulous testing and data science across each milestone of the customer journey.

***Proficiency in spoken and written English at an advanced level is required for this role.

A day in the life:

As a key player in our Analytics Engineering & BI team, you'll be at the forefront of how Power Digital designs, governs, and scales its Looker semantic layer. A critical part of your role will be owning the semantic layer modeling that powers every data product we ship, and making sure that layer serves multiple analytics surfaces including conversational analytics. You'll translate ambiguous stakeholder asks into flexible, durable models, ship best-in-class data products, and make sure every consumer of that model, human or AI, gets the right answer every time.

Responsibilities:

- Own and evolve Power Digital's enterprise LookML semantic layer as the governed foundation for analytics across our 1,000+ person organization and 600+ clients.
- Write scalable and performant LookML with rich metadata to support emerging conversational analytics use cases
- Translate ambiguous stakeholder and client asks into clear technical implementations, then design and optimize Looker assets that support scalable, reusable self-service analytics.
- Build best-in-class data products in Looker for internal stakeholders and clients, applying strong data visualization and UI/UX principles.
- Design LookML for scale and performance, partnering with Analytics Engineering on aggregate layer tuning and query optimization, and deploy and govern LookML across multiple Looker instances.
- Own the LookML style guide and naming conventions, train and support users adopting self-service analytics, and mentor junior developers and analysts.
- Employ AI technologies to maximize team leverage and efficiency.
- Other applicable or related duties as assigned.

Role Requirements:

  • 4+ years owning the full lifecycle of production-grade LookML models and data products
  • Advanced SQL proficiency with a modern cloud data warehouse (Snowflake and BigQuery preferred).
  • Strong foundation in dimensional modeling and data warehousing fundamentals.
  • Agency experience, including performance marketing analytics. Comfortable with the measurement, channels, and multi-client pace of a digital marketing agency serving multiple clients from eComm to B2B
  • Experience deploying and governing LookML across multiple Looker instances.
  • Experience with extensible LookML and modular visualizations in a multi-tenant environment
  • Experience mentoring and leveling-up the technical expertise of junior team members.
  • Experience with git-based version control and CI/CD workflows.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, comfortable with both engineers and executives.

Nice to have:

    • Experience routing LLM queries (directing natural-language questions to the right model/Explore.)
    • Conversational Analytics or comparable natural-language BI tooling experience.
    • Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools for accelerated LookML development
    • dbt or equivalent analytics engineering experience

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

- Reuse / leverage ratio: within the first 6 months, achieve >50% of client-facing reporting delivered from shared, governed semantic components (vs. bespoke client-specific LookML). Thereafter, maintain >= 75% quarter-over-quarter, measured from Looker content lineage
- Self-service deflection: within the first 6 months, increase the share of analytical questions resolved by users independently (Self-Service functionality or Omega) to 50% vs. adhoc requests from Asana and Slack. Thereafter, maintain >= 75%
- Source-of-truth integrity: hold production metric-definition discrepancies and data-quality incidents at < 5%, reconciled at each monthly close across Looker and downstream surfaces (Pacing Sheets, LLMs).
- User Experience: 95% of production data products load in 5 seconds or less, measured weekly
- Code quality: 95% style-guide and naming-convention conformance, measured monthly

Most Important Things (MITs)

- Establish and maintain the LookML style guide, naming conventions, and metric-definition source of truth the rest of the team builds against.
- Deliver the highest-priority Looker data products for active client and internal engagements on committed timelines.
- Build and ensure routing scalability of the field-level semantic metadata required for Conversational Analytics and AI-driven queries.
- Partner with Analytics Engineering to methodically tune diagnose and clear performance bottlenecks on production data products.
- Mentor and deputize junior developers through hands-on PR review and pairing on modeling and visualization work.

jobs.description:
Senior AI Interaction Evaluator (Codex / Claude Code)

Contract | $100–$200/hour | 10–20 hrs/week | Start ASAP (through early May)

Check out this Loom video for more details!

We’re looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role.

You won’t be writing production code.

You’ll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What This Role Actually Is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios — focusing on:

  • Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful

  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment

  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste — not syntax correctness.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end-to-end

  • Judge whether outputs are:

    • Useful

    • Correct (at a high level)

    • Aligned with how a strong engineer would think

  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just code

  • Distinguish between different levels of response quality (e.g. what makes something a 2 vs 4)

  • Provide clear, opinionated feedback on:

    • What worked

    • What didn’t

    • What felt “off” or misleading

  • Help define what great looks like when interacting with tools like Cursor

What We Mean by “Taste”

We’re specifically looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?

  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?

  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?

  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments.

Who You Are

  • Staff / Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)

  • Strong background in one of the below:

    • TypeScript / JavaScript

    • Python

  • Hands-on experience using:

    • OpenAI Codex

    • Claude Code

    • Cursor

  • Deep familiarity with modern AI-assisted dev workflows

  • Able to evaluate code without needing to fully execute or deeply review every line

  • Comfortable giving direct, opinionated feedback

  • High bar for what “good engineering” looks like

Nice to Have

  • Experience with tools like Cursor or similar AI-first IDEs

  • Prior exposure to prompt design or evaluation workflows

  • Experience mentoring senior engineers or defining engineering standards

Engagement Details

  • Rate: $100–$200/hour

  • Hours: ~10–20 hours/week

  • Duration: Through early May (with possible extension)

  • Start: ASAP

  • Process:

    • Take-home evaluation exercise

    • One behavioral interview

The DRAGEN Bioinformatics team develops industry-leading secondary analysis solutions for DNA and RNA NGS applications used by researchers and clinicians worldwide. jobs.description:
About Us

In partnership with SBI Group, we aim to bring the majority of Japanese equities on-chain, creating a secure, transparent, and high-performance trading infrastructure that can support institutional volumes while remaining accessible to retail participants. We are building a next-generation decentralized exchange with a fully on-chain order book. Our system is built with a custom state transition function and consensus layer, purpose-designed for high-performance, low-latency trading. The goal is to deliver a trustless platform that matches the speed and efficiency of traditional trading engines while providing full transparency by running execution as close as possible to the blockchain itself.

Position Overview

We are looking for a Senior Rust Engineer with strong expertise in system architecture and execution engines. You will be responsible for designing and implementing the CLOB execution layer, including the order book, matching engine, and blockchain client logic. This role is highly technical and requires end-to-end ownership of critical components, from architecture to optimization. While you’ll primarily collaborate with a remote team of experienced engineers, there will occasionally be opportunities to work onsite during offsite sessions to support onboarding and enable more efficient collaboration.

Joining at this early stage of development offers a unique opportunity to influence critical technical decisions, achieve career growth, and enjoy competitive compensation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement the on-chain order book and matching engine in Rust.
  • Design and extend exchange-specific logic (order execution, risk checks, account/state management).
  • Design and develop protocol-level components, such as state transition logic, consensus, validator interaction, and transaction processing pipelines.
  • Implement integration with oracles, bridges, and external data providers, ensuring correctness and resilience in adversarial conditions.
  • Optimize for low-latency execution, concurrency, and gas efficiency.
  • Conduct benchmarking and stress testing to identify and address potential performance/throughput bottlenecks.
  • Develop and maintain a comprehensive suite of unit, integration, and end-to-end tests to ensure code reliability and functionality.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of systems programming experience, with 3+ years in Rust.
  • Proven track record building trading platforms, execution engines, or exchanges (DEX or centralized).
  • Contributions to Rust-based L1 protocol projects (e.g., Solana, Cosmos SDK, Substrate).
  • Deep understanding of distributed computing principles, including consensus algorithms, peer-to-peer (P2P) networking, and high-performance data structures.
  • Deep knowledge of decentralized trading models (on-chain order books, AMMs, hybrid architectures).
  • Ability to design and implement complex, production-grade systems independently.

Big Bonus

  • Experience with competitive programming or algorithmic problem solving.
  • Expertise in low-latency design, concurrency, and performance optimization.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description Summary‎ Position Summary The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted strategic advisor and operational partner to the Chief Executive Officer (or Vice President, Strategy), helping maximize executive effectiveness while accelerating execution of Mosaic Health’s highest-priority strategic initiatives.
jobs.description:
Job Description Summary

‎

Position Summary
The Chief of Staff serves as a trusted strategic advisor and operational partner to the Chief Executive Officer (or Vice President, Strategy), helping maximize executive effectiveness while accelerating execution of Mosaic Health’s highest-priority strategic initiatives.
This is a highly visible leadership role responsible for driving enterprise coordination, executive operating cadence, strategic execution, transformation initiatives, and executive communications across the organization. Acting as an extension of executive leadership, the Chief of Staff ensures priorities are translated into action, cross-functional teams remain aligned, and critical initiatives are executed with discipline and urgency.
The successful candidate will thrive in a fast-paced, private equity-backed environment and possess the judgment, business acumen, and influence required to work effectively across executive leadership, Board members, business unit leaders, and external stakeholders. This role requires someone who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, solving complex operational challenges, and driving flawless execution.

‎

How will you make an impact & Requirements

‎

What You’ll Do

Executive Office Leadership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor and operational extension of the CEO (or VP, Strategy), ensuring executive focus remains on the organization’s highest-value priorities.
  • Manage executive priorities by coordinating decisions, tracking commitments, and ensuring timely execution of follow-up actions.
  • Anticipate leadership needs and proactively resolve issues before they require executive intervention.
  • Prepare the CEO for Board meetings, sponsor interactions, customer meetings, investor discussions, and other strategic engagements.
  • Continuously improve executive workflows by identifying opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and technology to increase productivity.

Executive Leadership Team Effectiveness

  • Own and continuously improve the Executive Leadership Team’s operating cadence.
  • Develop executive meeting agendas, pre-read materials, action logs, decision trackers, and governance processes.
  • Ensure accountability for enterprise commitments through disciplined follow-up and progress tracking.
  • Connect priorities across business units and corporate functions to identify risks, dependencies, and opportunities.
  • Foster collaboration across the executive team while promoting transparency, alignment, and shared accountability.

Strategy Execution & Enterprise Initiatives

  • Translate executive priorities into actionable workplans with defined milestones, owners, timelines, and measurable outcomes.
  • Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives that span multiple business units or lack a natural organizational owner.
  • Partner with senior leaders to remove execution barriers and accelerate enterprise priorities.
  • Develop executive dashboards and progress reports that provide visibility into strategic initiatives and organizational performance.
  • Support annual strategic planning and enterprise prioritization activities.

Enterprise Transformation

  • Coordinate enterprise transformation initiatives in partnership with executive leadership.
  • Maintain executive project plans, governance documentation, milestone tracking, dependency management, and decision logs.
  • Support organizational redesign, business integration, and enterprise change management initiatives.
  • Ensure transformation efforts remain aligned with Mosaic Health’s strategic objectives and value creation plan.

Executive Communications & Board Support

  • Develop polished executive presentations, Board materials, sponsor updates, and strategic communications.
  • Improve the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of executive messaging across internal and external audiences.
  • Coordinate responses to Board members, investors, and private equity sponsors.
  • Ensure executives are equipped with high-quality materials that enable informed decision-making and effective stakeholder engagement.

Organizational Leadership

  • Build trusted relationships with executives, business leaders, and functional teams across Mosaic Health.
  • Influence without formal authority through credibility, collaboration, and exceptional follow-through.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
  • Serve as a connector across the organization, helping leaders navigate complex issues and align around shared priorities.

What You’ll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
  • Eight or more years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, business operations, private equity, corporate development, investment banking, healthcare operations, or a Chief of Staff role supporting senior executives.
  • Experience working directly with a CEO or executive leadership team in a complex, high-growth organization.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise-wide, cross-functional strategic initiatives.
  • Exceptional analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation development.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple high-priority initiatives simultaneously while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially PowerPoint and Excel.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools and automation to improve business processes and executive productivity.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience within healthcare services, value-based care, managed care, provider organizations, or healthcare technology.
  • Experience working in a private equity-backed organization.
  • Familiarity with Board governance, investor communications, and sponsor reporting.
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, organizational integration, or enterprise transformation initiatives.

Leadership Competencies

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

  • Exceptional integrity, discretion, and sound judgment.
  • Strong enterprise and commercial acumen.
  • Executive presence and emotional intelligence.
  • Ability to influence senior leaders without formal authority.
  • Outstanding organizational discipline and follow-through.
  • Strategic thinking combined with operational execution.
  • Ability to synthesize complex information into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Resourcefulness, adaptability, and resilience in a fast-moving environment.
  • High humility, low ego, and a collaborative leadership style.
  • A continuous improvement mindset with a passion for simplifying complexity.

Success in the Role

Within the first 12 months, the successful Chief of Staff will:

  • Significantly increase executive leadership effectiveness through disciplined operating cadence and organizational alignment.
  • Improve CEO leverage by assuming responsibility for high-impact strategic and operational work.
  • Deliver Board materials, executive presentations, and strategic communications that consistently require minimal executive revision.
  • Successfully coordinate enterprise strategic initiatives from planning through execution.
  • Strengthen accountability across executive workstreams through transparent governance and follow-through.
  • Improve cross-functional collaboration and visibility into enterprise priorities.
  • Implement AI-enabled workflows that enhance executive productivity and organizational efficiency.
  • Become a trusted advisor to executive leadership, Board members, and private equity sponsors through thoughtful judgment, credibility, and flawless execution.

Mosaic Health is committed to building an inclusive workplace where talented individuals from diverse backgrounds can thrive. We believe better care begins with empowered people, collaborative teams, and leaders who are passionate about improving the health of the communities we serve.

If you’re energized by solving complex problems, influencing enterprise-wide strategy, and helping shape the future of healthcare delivery, we’d love to hear from you.

The best person for this is someone who has actually gone into client environments and carried AI deployments to production, has opinions about what a sound deployment looks like, and can tell an experienced engineer why their approach is wrong.

Your audience: Working production engineers, not career changers, with six to fifteen years in, mostly backend, with senior and staff engineers and the occasional engineering manager. What they're missing is agentic systems and the client-facing half of delivery.

  • Host live events focused on deploying AI systems inside a client's environment: discovery and scoping, agentic architecture, integration with enterprise systems, rollout, and adoption.

Risk Analyst / Risk Manager (Financial Risk, Compliance & GRC) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We’re hiring a highly analytical Risk Analyst / Risk Manager to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate financial, operational, compliance, and enterprise risks.

This is a hands-on risk management role focused on enterprise risk, internal controls, regulatory compliance, risk modeling, GRC, and audit readiness.

You’ll partner with Finance, Operations, IT, Legal, Compliance, and leadership to strengthen controls, maintain regulatory compliance, and provide actionable insights that support risk-aware business decisions.

If you have experience in risk management, compliance, audit, GRC, financial risk, or internal controls, this role could be a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Enterprise Risk Assessment

  • Conduct risk assessments across:
    • Financial risk
    • Operational risk
    • Compliance risk
    • Vendor risk
    • Technology risk
  • Maintain risk registers, mitigation plans, and incident trackers.
  • Evaluate risk based on:
    • Likelihood
    • Business impact
    • Control effectiveness
  • Prioritize mitigation initiatives and escalate material risks.

Financial Risk Modeling & Analysis

  • Analyze financial, market, and operational risk exposures.
  • Build and maintain risk models using:
    • SQL
    • Python
    • R
    • SAS
  • Perform:
    • Stress testing
    • Scenario analysis
    • Trend analysis
    • Forecasting
  • Apply quantitative techniques such as:
    • Value at Risk (VaR)
    • Monte Carlo simulations
    • Regression analysis
    • Probability modeling

Compliance & Regulatory Risk

  • Support compliance with applicable frameworks and regulations, including:
    • SOX
    • Basel III
    • Dodd-Frank
    • GDPR
    • HIPAA
    • PCI-DSS
  • Prepare risk and compliance reports.
  • Maintain documentation supporting regulatory requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits.
  • Keep governance and compliance records organized and audit-ready.

Internal Controls & GRC

  • Test and validate internal controls and operational safeguards.
  • Monitor incidents, control gaps, and risk events.
  • Work with GRC platforms such as:
    • Archer
    • ServiceNow
    • LogicManager
  • Support:
    • Vendor risk assessments
    • Cyber risk assessments
    • Operational control testing
  • Partner with IT and security teams to strengthen risk controls.

Risk Reporting & Dashboards

  • Build dashboards and reporting using:
    • Power BI
    • Tableau
    • Looker
  • Track key risk indicators and mitigation progress.
  • Prepare clear reports for leadership and stakeholders.
  • Translate complex findings into practical business recommendations.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • Highly analytical and comfortable working with complex risk scenarios.
  • Strong understanding of risk, governance, compliance, and internal controls.
  • Able to identify potential risks before they become larger business issues.
  • Comfortable working with both quantitative data and regulatory frameworks.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation discipline.
  • Able to translate technical risk findings into clear business recommendations.
  • Proactive, organized, and comfortable owning projects independently.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 3+ years of experience in:
    • Risk analysis
    • Risk management
    • Compliance
    • Audit
    • Governance / GRC
  • Strong proficiency with SQL.
  • Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
  • Experience with GRC platforms such as Archer, ServiceNow, LogicManager, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Enterprise risk management
    • Internal controls
    • Regulatory compliance
    • Governance processes
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Certifications such as:
    • FRM
    • CFA
    • CPA
    • CCEP
  • Experience with Value at Risk (VaR), stress testing, or financial risk modeling.
  • Python, R, or SAS experience.
  • Experience within:
    • Financial services
    • Fintech
    • SaaS
    • Healthcare
  • Experience supporting:
    • Board-level risk reporting
    • Enterprise governance
    • Regulatory audits
    • Audit preparation
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity and third-party/vendor risk.

Tools & Technology

  • SQL
  • Excel / Google Sheets
  • Python / R / SAS
  • Power BI / Tableau / Looker
  • Archer / ServiceNow / LogicManager
  • GRC and compliance reporting platforms

What a Typical Day Looks Like

Your day may include:

  • Reviewing risk dashboards and incident reports.
  • Conducting enterprise or operational risk assessments.
  • Updating risk registers and mitigation plans.
  • Analyzing financial and operational exposures.
  • Testing internal controls.
  • Preparing compliance and audit documentation.
  • Building risk reports and dashboards.
  • Meeting with Finance, IT, Legal, and Compliance stakeholders.
  • Identifying control gaps and recommending mitigation strategies.

In short: you identify risks early, strengthen controls, maintain compliance, and give leadership the information needed to make better risk-aware decisions.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and timely risk reporting.
  • Reduction in operational and compliance risk exposure.
  • Strong internal control effectiveness.
  • No missed regulatory or audit deadlines.
  • High-quality, audit-ready governance documentation.
  • Timely mitigation of identified risks.
  • Clear and actionable reporting to leadership.

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on organizational risk and governance.
  • Exposure across Finance, Compliance, Operations, IT, and Cybersecurity.
  • Opportunity to improve and scale enterprise risk frameworks.
  • Direct collaboration with leadership and cross-functional teams.
  • High ownership in a fully remote environment.
  • Career growth toward:
    • Senior Risk Manager
    • Enterprise Risk Lead
    • Compliance Leadership
    • Governance & Controls Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Technical / Risk Scenario Discussion
  4. Final Interview
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you have experience in risk management, GRC, compliance, internal controls, or financial risk and can turn complex risk data into actionable business insights, we’d love to hear from you.

The Field Marketing Manager bridges the gap between national brand strategy and local business performance.   • Protect their bottom line.
  • Maximize return on marketing investment.
  • Generate sustainable, profitable growth.
  • Make confident, data-informed business decisions.

As a franchisee-first organization, we believe our success is directly tied to the success of the owners we serve. The Field Marketing Manager is one of the most important advocates for that success.

Drive Local Business Performance

Support the localized performance strategy for your assigned franchise owners by connecting marketing investments to measurable business outcomes.

jobs.description:
Role Organization

Role Title: Network Engineer Team Lead

Team: Project Services

Reporting to: Network Team Manager

Company Overview

At NetCov, we specialize in delivering cutting-edge IT and cybersecurity solutions designed to protect and optimize the digital infrastructure for the industries we serve. We differentiate ourselves through deep knowledge of our clients’ business and a commitment to exceptional service.

About the Role

As a senior member of the Project Services Team, the Network Engineer Team Lead architects and implements complex network infrastructures across on-premises, hybrid, and cloud environments (Azure, AWS), partnering with the Network Architect on solution design and review, while leading and developing the network engineering function. The role combines deep technical expertise with leadership: setting standards, mentoring engineers, and ensuring consistent, high-quality delivery.

Serving as the technical authority for all network engagements, the Team Lead is accountable for quality, documentation, and risk management, and for resolving advanced networking issues across the client base, taking projects from inception to production and end-user attestation.

Technical Responsibilities
  • Architect and implement complex on-premises, virtual, and cloud (AWS/Azure) network infrastructures, taking projects from inception through production and end-user attestation.
  • Partner with the Network Team Architect to design, review, and validate network solutions prior to implementation.
  • Troubleshoot network-impacting outages quickly and efficiently in unfamiliar environments, with minimal client impact.
  • Implement and support advanced routing (OSPF, BGP, VRRP, HSRP), L2 technologies (STP variants, 802.1x, 802.1ad), and core services (DHCP, DNS, RADIUS/NPS).
  • Design and troubleshoot VPN and tunneling technologies, including SSL/TLS, IPSEC, policy-based VPNs, and GRE.
  • Work hands-on in the CLI across Cisco, Palo Alto, SonicWall, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, and Ruckus platforms.
  • Standardize and maintain accurate documentation of client network environments before handoff to support teams.
Leadership Responsibilities
  • Provide day-to-day leadership, mentoring, and coaching to network engineers and project resources from technical oversight
  • Review network designs, implementation plans, and documentation before client delivery.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for complex networking challenges and lead high-visibility engagements.
  • Identify risks early, drive process improvement and automation, and partner with the Engineering, Escalations, and Service Desk teams on seamless handoffs.
  • Support the Network Team Manager with interviews and hiring of the network engineers.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities Required
  • Experience:3-5 years of high-level, hands-on networking experience, ideally within an MSP or multi-client environment.
  • Networking:Deep expertise in the TCP/IP stack, L2/L3 forwarding, advanced routing (OSPF, BGP, VRRP, HSRP), and L2 technologies (STP, 802.1x, 802.1ad).
  • Services & Security:Hands-on with DHCP, DNS, RADIUS (NPS), and VPN/tunneling (SSL/TLS, IPSEC, GRE).
  • Vendor Platforms:CLI-level experience with Cisco, Palo Alto, SonicWall, Meraki, Fortinet, Aruba, and Ruckus.
  • Cloud:Strong understanding of AWS and Azure networking.
  • Leadership & Communication:Proven ability to mentor engineers, set standards, and communicate clearly with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Certifications:Cisco CCNA or greater, AWS Solutions Architect, and/or Azure Network Engineer certification (or similar) preferred.

Role Logistics

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.
  • This position may require travel to clients or company offices as needed.

Job Requisition ID #

26WD100437

26WD100437 Senior DevOps Developer

L'affichage de poste en français suivra / The French job posting follows

Position Overview

At Autodesk, we are changing how people design and create, empowering them to imagine, design, and make a better world. We believe in the power of automation and cutting-edge technology to inspire creativity. The Bidding group within Autodesk Construction Solutions is looking for an experienced Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)/DevOps Developer to help build, operate, and continuously improve highly available, resilient, and scalable cloud-native services that power our customers' critical workflows.

In this role, you will partner closely with Software Engineering, Infrastructure, and Platform teams to improve developer productivity, strengthen platform reliability, automate operational processes, and enhance observability across production services. You will own service health, operational excellence, disaster recovery readiness, security compliance, and CI/CD automation while driving continuous improvements in monitoring, infrastructure as code, and incident management.

Your work will include building and maintaining Kubernetes-based workloads, AWS infrastructure, MongoDB-backed services, observability platforms such as Dynatrace, cloud automation, disaster recovery solutions, and secure operational processes that enable engineering teams to deliver software reliably and efficiently.

You will report to the Manager, Software Development as part of a remote team (distributed engineering team).

Minimum Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Infrastructure & Systems teams to design and implement innovative solutions that improve developer velocity, infrastructure resiliency, security, and availability

  • Establish, hone, and facilitate adherence to team SLO / SLI targets

  • Drive processes, including service reviews, fire drills, chaos testing, incident response, and incident post mortem's

  • Collaborate with partners to understand requirements, use cases, and build towards a cohesive strategy

  • Develop scripts and tooling to execute deployment and configuration for service updates

  • Engage in deep technical discussions that shape robust, performant solutions

  • Coordinate and perform major upgrades with zero downtime

  • Keep systems updated for security compliance

  • Troubleshoot complex technical problems

  • Solve live performance, stability issues and prevent recurrence

  • Participate in on-call rotations to support production systems

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of production experience in large-scale cloud-based Infrastructure (AWS preferred)

  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, including at least two years working experience as an SRE Developer

  • Ability to track and prioritize multiple tasks coming in simultaneously

  • Excellent problem-solving skills

  • Ability to work independently

  • Understanding of DevOps best practices, architectures, and methods

  • Experience with scripting languages, including one or more of Javascript, Python, Linux/Unix Shell

  • Experience with cloud-native applications

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and container orchestration

  • Experience managing SaaS database solutions (e.g. MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, Redshift, etc.)

  • Experience with configuration management tools and cloud automation (e.g. TerraForm, Chef, Ansible, etc.)

  • Experience defining and building CI/CD processes and working with common CI/CD tools (e.g. Jenkins / Circle CI / Spinnaker, etc.)

  • Experience building applications on AWS using services such as Step functions, IAM, EC2, S3, CloudWatch and Lambda

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Agile software development practices

  • Experience consuming, designing, and implementing REST APIs

  • Experience with networking and security concepts

  • Experience with log ingestion, monitoring and discoverability tools (New Relic, Splunk, DataDog, BugSnag)

  • Security/audit experience e.g. SOC2, FedRAMP, etc.

26WD100437 Développeur DevOps Senior

Aperçu du Poste

Chez Autodesk, nous transformons la façon dont les gens conçoivent et créent, en leur donnant les moyens d’imaginer, de concevoir et de bâtir un monde meilleur. Nous croyons au pouvoir de l’automatisation et des technologies de pointe pour inspirer la créativité. Le groupe Bidding au sein d’Autodesk Construction Solutions est à la recherche d’un ingénieur en fiabilité des sites (SRE) / développeur DevOps expérimenté pour aider à mettre en place, à exploiter et à améliorer continuellement des services natifs du nuage hautement disponibles, résilients et évolutifs qui alimentent les flux de travail critiques de nos clients.

Dans ce rôle, vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d’ingénierie logicielle, d’infrastructure et de plateforme afin d’améliorer la productivité des développeurs, de renforcer la fiabilité de la plateforme, d’automatiser les processus opérationnels et d’améliorer l’observabilité à travers les services de production. Vous serez responsable de l’état de santé des services, de l’excellence opérationnelle, de la préparation à la reprise après sinistre, de la conformité en matière de sécurité et de l’automatisation CI/CD, tout en favorisant l’amélioration continue de la surveillance, de l’infrastructure en tant que code et de la gestion des incidents.

Votre travail consistera notamment à mettre en place et à maintenir des charges de travail basées sur Kubernetes, l’infrastructure AWS, des services s’appuyant sur MongoDB, des plateformes d’observabilité telles que Dynatrace, l’automatisation du nuage, des solutions de reprise après sinistre, ainsi que des processus opérationnels sécurisés permettant aux équipes d’ingénierie de livrer des logiciels de manière fiable et efficace.

Vous relèverez du gestionnaire du développement logiciel au sein d’une équipe à distance (équipe d’ingénierie distribuée).

Responsabilités Minimales

  • Collaborer avec les équipes d’infrastructure et de systèmes pour concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions innovantes qui améliorent la vélocité des développeurs, la résilience de l’infrastructure, la sécurité et la disponibilité

  • Établir, affiner et faciliter le respect des cibles SLO / SLI de l’équipe

  • Piloter les processus, notamment les revues de services, les exercices d’urgence, les tests de chaos, la réponse aux incidents et les analyses rétrospectives d’incidents

  • Collaborer avec les partenaires pour comprendre les exigences et les cas d’utilisation, et élaborer une stratégie cohérente

  • Développer des scripts et des outils pour exécuter le déploiement et la configuration des mises à jour de services

  • Participer à des discussions techniques approfondies qui permettent de concevoir des solutions robustes et performantes

  • Coordonner et effectuer des mises à niveau majeures sans aucun temps d’arrêt

  • Maintenir les systèmes à jour pour assurer la conformité en matière de sécurité

  • Résoudre des problèmes techniques complexes

  • Résoudre les problèmes de performance et de stabilité en temps réel et prévenir leur récurrence

  • Participer aux rotations d’astreinte pour assurer le soutien des systèmes de production

Qualifications Minimales

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en production au sein d’une infrastructure cloud à grande échelle (AWS de préférence)

  • Au moins 5 ans d’expérience en génie logiciel, dont au moins deux ans en tant que développeur SRE

  • Capacité à suivre et à prioriser plusieurs tâches arrivant simultanément

  • Excellentes compétences en résolution de problèmes

  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome

  • Compréhension des meilleures pratiques, des architectures et des méthodes DevOps

  • Expérience avec les langages de script, notamment au moins l’un des suivants : JavaScript, Python, shell Linux/Unix

  • Expérience avec les applications natives du nuage

  • Expérience avec Docker, Kubernetes et l’orchestration de conteneurs

  • Expérience dans la gestion de solutions de bases de données SaaS (p. ex. MongoDB Atlas, DynamoDB, Redshift, etc.)

  • Expérience avec les outils de gestion de configuration et d’automatisation du nuage (p. ex. TerraForm, Chef, Ansible, etc.)

  • Expérience dans la définition et la mise en place de processus d’intégration continue et de déploiement continu (CI/CD) et dans l’utilisation d’outils CI/CD courants (p. ex. Jenkins / Circle CI / Spinnaker, etc.)

  • Expérience dans le développement d’applications sur AWS à l’aide de services tels que Step Functions, IAM, EC2, S3, CloudWatch et Lambda

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Expérience des pratiques de développement logiciel Agile

  • Expérience de l’utilisation, de la conception et de la mise en œuvre d’API REST

  • Expérience des concepts de réseautage et de sécurité

  • Expérience des outils d’ingestion de journaux, de surveillance et de détection (New Relic, Splunk, DataDog, BugSnag)

  • Expérience en sécurité et en audit (p. ex. SOC2, FedRAMP, etc.)

Role Overview

Zeta Global is seeking a hands-on Senior Engineering Manager to lead a critical area of the application platform that powers the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP).

Reporting to SVP Engineering, this leader will own the technical execution, architecture, roadmap, and delivery for one or more core platform domains. The role requires strong technical judgment, exceptional engineering leadership, and the ability to drive complex initiatives across multiple engineering teams.

This is a deeply technical leadership role. The Senior Engineering Manager is expected to remain actively involved in architecture, design reviews, technical decision-making, and production operations while developing engineers and technical leads and delivering reliable platform capabilities at scale.

Platform Engineering Mission

Platform Engineering delivers the shared application primitives, services, and guardrails that enable product engineering teams to build consistent, scalable, secure, and reliable applications across ZMP.

The team's mission is to provide reusable platform capabilities that improve developer productivity while ensuring platform consistency, operational excellence, and long-term architectural sustainability.

Scope of Ownership

Own multiple core application platform domains, which include, but not limited to:

  • Platform authentication and authorization
  • Account, organization, workspace, and tenant management
  • Notifications and messaging infrastructure
  • Shared application services and reusable platform primitives
  • Platform APIs, API Gateway and extension mechanisms
  • Common developer frameworks and platform tooling
  • Shared operational capabilities

The Senior Engineering Manager is accountable for the architecture, implementation, operational excellence, and adoption of their platform domains.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Lead the architecture and technical direction for assigned platform domains.
  • Translate platform strategy into executable engineering roadmaps.
  • Drive technical design for shared services, APIs, schemas, and reusable platform capabilities.
  • Review designs and ensure alignment with platform architecture and engineering standards.
  • Identify scalability, reliability, security, and maintainability risks.
  • Champion reusable solutions and eliminate unnecessary duplication across product teams.
  • Guide migrations, versioning, and adoption of platform capabilities.

  • Build and lead a high-performing team of platform engineers and technical leads.

  • Work with other engineering teams to champion the platform domains and their benefits, drive adoption of the services

Platform Delivery

  • Deliver platform capabilities that simplify and accelerate product development.
  • Partner with product engineering teams to understand platform requirements and improve developer experience.
  • Build self-service capabilities that reduce friction and increase platform adoption.
  • Measure platform success through adoption, reliability, developer productivity, and operational efficiency.

Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Partner with Product Engineering, Data Platform, Architecture, SRE, DevOps, Security, and FinOps teams.

  • Resolve technical dependencies and implementation challenges.
  • Drive alignment around platform standards and engineering best practices.
  • Communicate technical trade-offs, priorities, and delivery risks clearly.

Reliability, Security, and Operational Excellence

  • Ensure shared platform services meet availability, latency, scalability, and recovery objectives.
  • Embed observability, monitoring, capacity planning, and operational readiness into platform design.
  • Improve tenant isolation, workload fairness, and platform resiliency.
  • Partner with Security teams to build secure-by-default platform capabilities.
  • Drive continuous improvements in operational efficiency, reliability, and cloud cost optimization.

Success Measures

Success will be measured through:

  • Delivery of platform roadmap commitments
  • Adoption of shared platform capabilities
  • Platform availability, reliability, and operational health
  • Improved developer productivity and satisfaction
  • Successful migrations and retirement of legacy services
  • Team engagement, growth, and engineering effectiveness

  • Strong technical expertise in distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures, and shared platform services.

jobs.excerpt: Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.
jobs.description:
Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment.

What this opportunity involves We're building a dataset to evaluate AI coding agents - how well a model handles real-world developer tasks.

You'll create challenging tasks and evaluation criteria within realistic simulated environments:

  • Build realistic developer environments - a virtual company with codebase, infrastructure, and context (tickets, docs, conversations) that forms a believable development history
  • Design tasks from intermediate states of these environments - craft the prompt, define what "solved" means, and ensure the task is solvable by an AI agent
  • Write tests that verify agent solutions - accept all valid approaches and reject incorrect ones, neither too strict nor too lenient
  • Iterate on tasks and tests based on QA feedback - review agent solutions, analyze failures, and refine until the evaluation is fair and robust

What this is NOT

  • Not data labeling
  • Not prompt engineering
  • Not writing code from scratch - the agent writes most of the code; you guide and evaluate

What we look for

  • 5+ years in software development
  • Core stack: Python (FastAPI), JavaScript/TypeScript (React), Docker, Postgres, Kafka, Redis
  • Experience writing tests (functional, integration)
  • English proficiency - B2+

Why this is hard

Frontier models are already good at coding. Creating a task that genuinely challenges the best models is non-trivial. You need to deeply understand where models fail and what scenarios reveal the difference between a good and a bad solution. Tasks have many valid solutions - writing tests that accept all correct solutions and reject incorrect ones is harder than it sounds.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid

Compensation

Up to $40/hr equivalent, depending on level and pace. Tasks are estimated at ~20 hours each; you set your own schedule.

  • Familiarity with deployment and infrastructure tooling such as Vercel, Railway, or similar

How to Apply

If you are a strong full stack engineer who can build real AI-powered systems, work independently without being managed, and ship things that actually work and produce results, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Biostatistician II (Part-Time)

Job Title: Biostatistician II (Part-Time)

Location: Remote

Organization: Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA)

Job Type: Contractor, part-time (up to 20 hours per week, on average)

Travel: Willingness to travel up to twice per year for team meetings

Reports to: Chief Research and Quality Officer

Cardiovascular disease is the single largest contributor to premature death and disability in the world. At CVAUSA, we are dedicated to delivering the highest quality cardiovascular care and to advancing scientific discovery through clinical research, including randomized trials and observational and health outcomes research. As we build our clinical programs and our national network of cardiovascular research, we need strong team members who are passionate about generating rigorous real-world evidence that improves cardiovascular care.

Position Summary

The Biostatistician II will support CVAUSA's real-world evidence and observational research portfolio by independently leading the statistical analysis of defined studies across the network's community cardiology practices. This fully remote, part-time role is well suited to an experienced master's- or doctoral-level statistician who can draft statistical analysis plans, prepare and analyze real-world data from electronic health records, claims, and registries, and contribute to manuscripts, abstracts, and grant deliverables.

This role is ideal for a biostatistician who can work independently within defined project scopes, collaborate effectively with investigators and clinical stakeholders, and translate complex data into rigorous, reproducible analyses that support high-quality, evidence-based cardiovascular care.

Key Responsibilities

Independently conduct statistical analyses for assigned observational cohort, registry, and quality studies, including data preparation, cohort definition, and application of appropriate analytic methods.

Draft statistical analysis plans (SAPs) for defined studies and contribute to protocol and study design, including sample-size and power calculations.

Apply multivariable regression, survival analysis, longitudinal/mixed-effects models, and confounding-adjustment methods (e.g., propensity scoring) appropriate to real-world data.

Prepare, clean, link, and quality-control real-world datasets from EHR, claims, and registry sources, including phenotype and endpoint definition using standard code sets (e.g., ICD-10-CM, CPT).

Produce validated, reproducible analytic code (SAS and/or R) along with tables, listings, and figures for reports and publications.

Contribute substantively to abstracts, manuscripts, posters, and grant applications, including methods and results sections, in collaboration with investigators.

Communicate analytic findings clearly to investigators, clinical leaders, and other internal non-technical stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required

Master's degree (MS, MPH, or equivalent) in biostatistics, statistics, epidemiology, or a related quantitative discipline, plus approximately 2–5 years of applied experience; or a doctoral degree (PhD) in a relevant field.

Demonstrated ability to conduct multivariable and survival analyses independently and to interpret results accurately.

Strong proficiency in SAS and/or R, including data management of large, complex datasets.

Proficiency in SQL.

Proficiency and experience with missing-data approaches such as multiple imputation.

Experience drafting or substantially contributing to statistical analysis plans.

Experience with real-world data sources (EHR, administrative claims, clinical registries) and data-linkage or phenotyping methods.

Working knowledge of research data governance, HIPAA/PHI handling, and Good Clinical Practice principles.

Strong written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred

Proficiency with causal-inference and confounding-adjustment methods (propensity scores, matching, weighting).

Experience in cardiovascular clinical research, particularly cardiac imaging (e.g., PET/myocardial blood flow) and/or cardiac procedural care (e.g., coronary angiography, PCI, catheter ablation).

Served as biostatistician for 2+ prior outcomes/quality research projects.

Record of contribution to peer-reviewed publications or abstracts.

Proficient in using Power BI for data visualization.

Familiarity with cardiovascular code sets (ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT) and CMS data conventions.

Key Attributes

Comfortable working independently within defined project scopes and self-motivated.

Detail-oriented with strong analytical and organizational skills.

Able to balance multiple priorities in a fully remote, part-time environment.

Works collaboratively and is responsive to feedback.

Motivated by improving quality and outcomes in cardiovascular care.

Demonstrates a high level of integrity and professionalism.

Why Join Cardiovascular Associates of America

At CVAUSA, you'll help advance scientific discovery at a national scale, as part of the nation's largest network of cardiovascular care professionals. You'll have the opportunity to work closely with and learn from physician, quality, and research leaders. Your work will be more than just numbers and data; it will be foundational for our efforts to improve patient care and save lives. You'll join a mission-focused organization dedicated to excellence in cardiovascular care and clinical research.

Overview

An Industry Defining Company

Karoo is a venture-backed startup transforming cardiology care through a comprehensive, technology-enabled health management model that improves patient outcomes while reducing total cost of care and enhancing revenue opportunities for health plans. Karoo integrates a curated network of cardiac caregivers and providers, personalized care navigation, and a technology-driven care and key insights platform to rapidly address clinical and non-clinical needs throughout the patient journey. By proactively managing care and closing gaps, Karoo ensures that patients receive the right care without delay, reducing avoidable hospitalizations and improving longer-term outcomes, thereby creating revenue and cost of care savings opportunities for payers.

This is a rare opportunity to join a mission-driven founding team at a pivotal stage and help define the future of healthcare, with the power to improve the lives of patients with cardiovascular disease, the number one cause of death in America today.

The Role

Karoo Health is seeking a skilled and dedicated Senior Product Manager to join our team. As a product leader at Karoo Health, you show a clear passion for building products that work - not just in theory, but in the hands of real users. You are energized by ambiguity and want to work on problems that matter.

In order to do this job well, you must be a decisive, action-oriented operator who can turn messy, competing stakeholder needs into a clear product direction. You have a bias toward shipping an MVP, learning fast, and iterating, rather than waiting for perfect certainty. Knowing there are always multiple ways to solve a problem, you know how to make a call, move forward, and adjust course as new information comes in.

When applying, please include a description of why you're interested in this role.

What You’ll Do
  • Define: Own data-driven product definition end-to-end, from problem discovery through requirements, scoping, and prioritization.
  • Launch: Drive products from concept to MVP to market, then iterate based on real-world feedback and usage.
  • Decide: Make fast, well-reasoned decisions in the face of incomplete information, and know when to move forward vs. when to pause and validate.
  • Align Stakeholders: Partner closely with engineering, clinical, operations, and executive stakeholders to build shared understanding and drive consensus toward a single product direction.
  • Connect Systems: Work closely with engineering to navigate interoperability challenges across EHRs, payer systems, and other third-party healthcare data sources, translating technical constraints into product tradeoffs.
  • Prioritize: Build and maintain a roadmap that balances customer needs, business impact, and technical feasibility.
  • Communicate: Clearly articulate the "why" behind product decisions to technical and non-technical audiences alike. Produce various product artifacts, such as: workflows, diagrams, working prototypes, PRDs, user stories, etc. Comfort level with using AI productivity tools.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in product management, ideally at a startup or fast-paced environment, ideally within a clinical operations environment, with a track record of owning products from definition through launch.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and align diverse stakeholders (engineering, clinical, business, executive) toward a shared product direction.
  • Experience defining and shipping MVPs, then iterating based on user feedback and data.
  • Comfort making quick, high-conviction decisions without waiting for exhaustive hypothesis testing - while knowing when more validation is warranted.
  • Experience working on products involving system interoperability or complex data integrations (healthcare interoperability such as HL7/FHIR, EHR, or payer data a plus, but not required).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear requirements.
  • Ability to work independently and drive alignment without formal authority.
  • Healthcare, value-based care, or cardiology domain experience is a nice-to-have, not a requirement
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.
Why Join Us
  • Competitive salary and equity.
  • Fully-remote work environment available.
  • Full benefits package.
  • A collaborative and transparent company culture that values creativity and ownership.

jobs.excerpt: Organization OverviewTens of millions of people in the U.
jobs.description:
Organization Overview

Tens of millions of people in the U.S. live with chronic financial insecurity, inadequate savings, and no meaningful wealth, with deeply harmful consequences for themselves, their children, families, communities, employers, and the economy. Black, Latinx, and women-led households disproportionately experience financial insecurity due in large part to longstanding, systemic racism and gender discrimination. Addressing these issues is critical to Commonwealth's work of making wealth possible for all.

For over two decades, Commonwealth's fundamental purpose has remained to create a stronger and more prosperous society where everyone has financial opportunity. Our work has enabled over 2 million people to save nearly $8 billion on a path to greater financial security and wealth. We are now embarking on a new 4-year strategic plan that seeks greater impact and builds on our systems focus to expand workplace benefits, strengthen partnerships with financial institutions and fintech partners, and explore new frontiers like climate and generative AI.

Commonwealth strengthens the financial opportunity and security of financially vulnerable people by discovering ideas, piloting solutions, and driving innovations to scale. We understand broad change requires market players to act. That's why we take a unique approach to collaborate with consumers, the financial services industry, employers, policymakers, and mission-driven organizations. The solutions we build are grounded in real life, based on our deep understanding of people who are financially vulnerable and how businesses can best serve them.

For more than two decades, we have moved employers to prioritize worker financial security, the financial services industry to bring products to market that better serve financially vulnerable people, and policymakers to pass legislation and take action to enable savings and financial security. To learn more about the organization, please visit
buildcommonwealth.org.

Diversity of background and perspective are strengths that we value. We are committed to creating a diverse, dedicated, skilled, and collaborative environment, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Commonwealth recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, disability, age, veteran status, and other protected statuses.

Position Overview

Commonwealth is seeking a Senior Marketing Manager (SMM) to join our team. The role will be part of a passionate, highly cross-functional team dedicated to supporting Commonwealth's mission of creating systemic change for people living with financial insecurity. This individual will work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director, Senior Vice Presidents, Project Owners, Project Managers, and other members of the marketing team.

The SMM will serve as the marketing project lead for two or more projects and is responsible for ensuring the communications strategy and its implementation are aligned with and moving forward the overall goals of the project. Specific responsibilities include developing a marketing strategy to message and amplify specific project initiatives, creating a detailed marketing plan, and developing content such as project briefs, research reports, infographics, blog posts, and social media copy, in partnership and close collaboration with the project team(s). This individual will also work closely with the Strategic Marketing Director to ensure integration of owned content at an organizational and operational level, and to develop strategy around PR and events/conferences.

The right person for this role has a roll-up-your-sleeves, get-the-work-done mentality. This is a great opportunity for someone who can think strategically, has extensive knowledge of marketing best practices, thrives in a collaborative team, and makes decisions based on data. A best fit is someone who thrives as much in strategy planning as they do in operational execution. The SMM will project manage the communications plan execution and production implementation, ensuring timely content publication and promotion. Please join us if you are looking to contribute to a fast-paced, social impact organization.

Responsibilities

  • Support the marketing strategy, development, management, and production for two or more Commonwealth programs, ensuring that marketing goals are met and remain top of mind throughout the life of the project
  • Create project-specific marketing strategy canvases and marketing plans, including communication of KPIs in partnership with the Project Owner; continuously update the plan with new information and ensure the project team is aligned with strategies
  • Project manage and execute all aspects of the marketing plan, including content development, amplification plans, deployment strategies, and post-mortem activities; lead production management for projects and assets
  • Act as marketing contact and liaison with external partners
  • Liaise with strategic marketing team members leading events, press opportunities, social media, and newsletter
  • Write marketing copy for social media posts, newsletters, blogs, and other digital marketing assets
  • Draft grant deliverables summaries and contribute to funder trackers and reporting
  • Support partner demonstrations through contribution to research methodologies, research participant recruiting efforts, developing partner communications campaign materials, and partner engagement as needed
  • Communicate and partner with the strategic marketing team on PR and speaking opportunities
  • Actively promote continuous learning and improvement, applying marketing best practices to every project
  • Creatively problem-solve and collaborate with a small, results-oriented team to keep projects on track toward both short-term milestones and long-term strategic objectives
  • Contribute to a positive organizational culture with high optimism, appetite for learning, and eagerness to collaborate with colleagues

Skills/Competencies

  • Exceptional project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple complex projects concurrently with a high degree of organization, attention to detail, and flexibility
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills to coordinate multiple project deliverables with diverse stakeholders
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and prioritization skills
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to meet deadlines while working collaboratively with team members
  • Functions well under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Brings a positive attitude, flexibility, and a solutions orientation to challenging situations

  • Strong skills in Google Drive (Sheets, Docs, and Slides), Asana or a similar project management tool, and HubSpot
  • Passionate about the mission of Commonwealth and driving social change through promoting financial security and opportunity for the financially vulnerable
  • Excited about marketing and communications as a tool for influence and achieving social impact goals

  • Prior marketing/communications agency experience is strongly preferred
  • Prior D2C experience is valuable for work on partnership demonstrations and pilot programs.

Commonwealth offers a competitive salary and benefits, commensurate with experience and skills.

Our staff are the key to our success. The starting annual salary range for this full-time position is $81,000–$90,000, and Commonwealth also offers a generous compensation and benefits package that includes:

jobs.description:
Role Overview:

We are hiring an architect to raise the design floor across engineering through trusted, practical technical direction. You’ll shape a govtech platform spanning microservices, front-end replatforming, AI products, and AI-native delivery—making the system coherent, safe, and fast to change within a FedRAMP-conscious environment.

Responsibilities:

  • Own cross-cutting technical direction: service boundaries, contracts, data architecture, and platform evolution across our decomposition and replatforming programs
  • Design in the open: architecture decision records, design reviews inside our Plan-and-Review cadence, explicit trade-offs, and written reasoning others can challenge
  • Treat dependent teams as first-class customers: gather their requirements before designing, validate against real consumers before building, and close the loop when things change
  • Raise the floor: coach tech leads through their own designs; success is more people who can architect, not more decisions routed through you
  • Keep designs as simple as the problem allows; we treat unneeded complexity as a defect, not a signal of sophistication
  • Partner with AI Operations and DevOps so architecture is enforced by the delivery system (contracts, validation, gates) rather than by memo
  • Bring architectural judgment to how AI agents design and modify systems, so machine-produced code lands inside human-owned structure

Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of engineering experience, including several years driving architecture across multiple teams in SaaS or platform environments
  • A track record of designs that shipped and held up in production; we will ask what broke and what you learned
  • Real experience decomposing a monolith into services in production, with the scars to show for it
  • Fluency with AI-era architecture: agentic systems, LLM integration patterns, and designing for codebases partially produced by agents
  • Experience in regulated environments (FedRAMP, StateRAMP, HIPAA, or similar) is a strong plus
  • Exceptional written and verbal clarity; you make complex systems legible

Key Competencies

  • Comprehension before construction: you restate requirements in your own words and confirm them before you design
  • Visible uncertainty: you surface confusion early and loudly; silent guessing is the one behavior we cannot work with
  • Consumer empathy: the constraints of dependent teams are design inputs, not obstacles
  • Simplicity bias: the best design is the one the team can carry without you
  • Comfortable being wrong in public and fast to update

What This Role Is NOT

This is not an ivory-tower seat and not a gatekeeping seat. If your model of architecture is producing artifacts that other people must implement, or serving as the mandatory approval on every decision, this is not the fit. Architecture here is a service to the teams shipping, and its success is measured by how much better they design, not by how often they need you.

How We Work

We run an AI-native development lifecycle where agents help plan, build, validate, and release, while humans own judgment and direction. Our standards are simple: own and understand everything you ship, and surface uncertainty early.

What We Offer:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans, with significant employer contributions for employees AND dependents (contributions based on base-level plan; buyup plans available at additional costs)
  • Company-sponsored life/disabilities insurances
  • 11 Paid holidays
  • Flexible time off
  • 401k plan with 4% employer match
  • Monthly stipends for wellness and home office expenses

Je houdt ervan om grenzen te verleggen. En ook van nieuwe dingen leren. Je levert graag mooie resultaten en zet alles op alles om klanten goed te helpen. Je werkt makkelijk samen en ziet niet snel dingen over het hoofd. Klinkt bekend? Dan voel je je hier als een vis in ‘t water.

VetsEZ is currently looking for a Senior .NET Developer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable .NET-based APIs that power an Azure integration platform connecting CRM applications with enterprise backend databases. You will collaborate with architects, frontend developers, backend data teams, and QA engineers to deliver high-quality API solutions while supporting the modernization of existing .NET Framework services to .NET Core.

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience building RESTful APIs using C# and ASP.NET Web API, implementing secure authentication mechanisms, and delivering enterprise-grade integrations through Agile development practices. Experience with Azure cloud services and AI-assisted development tools is preferred to help improve development efficiency and software quality.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework, and .NET Core while implementing secure authentication using OAuth, JWT, or similar authentication protocols.
  • Develop, package, and deploy API solutions through automated CI/CD pipelines and publish services using Azure API Management for routing, versioning, policy enforcement, monitoring, and security.
  • Develop and execute unit, integration, and functional testing for .NET APIs to ensure application quality, performance, and reliability.
  • Collaborate with frontend developers, backend data providers, architects, and QA teams to define API designs, integration strategies, and testing approaches.
  • Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve production issues while maintaining detailed technical documentation and supporting ongoing platform enhancements.
  • Leverage AI-powered development tools to improve coding efficiency, testing, debugging, and overall software delivery within an Agile environment.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience, with 7+ years of experience developing enterprise applications using Microsoft .NET technologies.
  • Advanced experience developing RESTful APIs using C#, ASP.NET Web API, .NET Framework, and .NET Core.
  • Strong experience implementing secure authentication and authorization using OAuth, JWT, or similar identity and access management protocols.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, API deployment, Azure API Management, and software testing methodologies within enterprise application environments.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail and technical documentation abilities.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with experience working in Agile software development teams and cross-functional technical environments.

Additional Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure services, Azure App Services, Azure API Management, and cloud-native application development.
  • Experience migrating enterprise applications from .NET Framework to .NET Core or modern .NET platforms.
  • Experience supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Department of Defense (DoD), or other federal healthcare modernization programs, along with experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or ChatGPT.

Benefits

  • Medical/Dental/Vision
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • PTO + Federal Holidays
  • Corporate Laptop
  • Training Opportunities
  • Remote Opportunity

Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.

VetsEZ is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.
